title: Commertize sponsor glossary: twelve real-world asset classes
description: For each asset class: what it is, what tokenizing it means operationally, and what a sponsor supplies.
notice: General information about how Commertize operates. It is not legal, tax or investment advice, and it is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.
definition_of_tokenize: To tokenize an asset is to issue interests in, or backed by, the asset or the entity that owns it, and to keep the ownership register for those interests on a blockchain as tokens, with transfer restrictions built into the token.
status_meaning: Accepting sponsor inquiries means Commertize will review a sponsor's materials for this class. It is not a statement that any asset in the class has been tokenized or will be on any timeline.

classes.name: Commercial real estate
classes.what_it_is: Income-producing property: single-tenant net lease, industrial, multifamily, self-storage, hospitality and healthcare property companies.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The LLC that already holds title issues a new investor class, and that class's register is kept on chain as tokens. Distributions follow the operating agreement.
sponsor_supplies: Rent roll and leases (or lease abstracts)
Existing loan documents and lender acknowledgment of the new class

classes.name: Private-company equity
classes.what_it_is: Shares or units of an operating private company.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The company issues a new class (often non-voting preferred or units) or converts its existing cap table to an on-chain register.
sponsor_supplies: Charter and bylaws or operating agreement
Transfer restrictions, ROFR and drag-along terms

classes.name: Private credit and receivables
classes.what_it_is: Loans and contracted receivables that pay a defined stream.
classes.tokenize_it_means: An existing credit fund issues a new class or series of notes, or a purchaser entity buys the receivables and issues notes backed by them.

classes.name: Oil and gas royalties and minerals
classes.what_it_is: Mineral and royalty interests that receive a share of production revenue.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The existing mineral or royalty LLC issues a new class, so royalty deeds and division orders stay where they are.
sponsor_supplies: Division orders and operator pay decks

classes.name: Energy infrastructure: solar, storage and hydro
classes.what_it_is: Operating generation and storage projects with contracted revenue.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The sponsor's holding company or project company issues an investor class that receives project cash flow.
sponsor_supplies: Metering data separating generation and capacity

classes.name: Data centers
classes.what_it_is: Powered shell or turnkey facilities under a credit lease, and operating colocation.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The title-holding LLC issues an investor class; for a levered operator, a holding company above the lender's change-of-control perimeter issues non-voting units.

classes.name: GPU and compute
classes.what_it_is: Compute equipment and the contracted capacity revenue it earns.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The machine-owning entity or a holding company above it issues units that receive lease or capacity revenue, with lender consent and estoppel obtained first where the equipment is financed.

classes.name: Farmland
classes.what_it_is: Agricultural land and its lease or crop revenue.
classes.tokenize_it_means: An existing farm LLC issues a new investor class, after a check that state farm-ownership rules allow it.

classes.name: Sports venue receivables
classes.what_it_is: Contracted, assignable venue revenue such as premium seating, naming rights or concessions contracts.
classes.tokenize_it_means: A purchaser entity holds the receivable and issues notes backed by it; league and counterparty consents come first.
sponsor_supplies: Consent from the league and counterparties
Existing bond-indenture pledges on the same revenue

classes.name: Music and IP royalties
classes.what_it_is: Royalty income from music catalogs and other intellectual property.
classes.tokenize_it_means: A catalog or publishing company issues a class that tracks royalty income.

classes.name: Producing mines
classes.what_it_is: Operating mines and royalty or streaming interests in their output.
classes.tokenize_it_means: The operating company or an existing royalty holder issues a new class.

classes.name: Vaulted collectibles
classes.what_it_is: Art, watches, wine and other collectibles held in a vault.
classes.tokenize_it_means: A title token represents one specific item held in custody.
